topography.project_purpose: RWA. Structurally: 74 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 7 ERC20 tokens; built on foundry.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (batchedmulticall, multicall, reentrancyprotection). Dominant framework: foundry.
